rows.text: when the word `cx` and `edx` are both zero tail-jumps `00249840` with the incoming registers; otherwise stores byte 1 at `02F973A0`, byte 1 or 0 for `edx` non-zero at `02F973A2`, and the word `cx` at `02F973AA`, `02F973A8`, `02F973A6` and `02F973A4`, and returns `cx` zero-extended

takes the word `cx` as an id, loads the qword at `01EEBCC0 + (id >> 12)*0x58 + 8` and returns 0 when it is null; otherwise, in the 16-bit word at index `(id AND 0xFFF) >> 4` of that array, sets bit `id AND 0xF` when v is positive and clears it otherwise, where v is `edx` when `r8d` is non-zero and the old bit plus `edx` when `r8d` is zero; then calls `00325F40(id, old bit, new bit)`, also calls `0046A630(id, edx)` when `r8d` is zero and bit 0 of the fifth (stack) argument is set, and returns the new bit

calls `0031B760(rcx)` with the incoming `rcx` and returns 0 when the result is null, when bit 3 of its dword `+0` is clear, when its qword `+0x698` is null or when byte `+5` of that object is non-zero; otherwise returns the inverse of bit 23 of the dword `+0`

calls `0031B760(rcx)` with the incoming `rcx` and returns 0 when the result is null or bit 4 of its byte `+0` is clear; otherwise loads its qword `+0x698` and, when the OR of that object's dwords `+0x64` and `+0x3C` has any bit of `0x8000201B` set, returns bit 23 of the result's dword `+0`; else, when the `+0x698` pointer is non-null and its byte `+5` is zero, tail-jumps `00308130(result, that pointer)`, and otherwise tail-jumps `00308040(result, 0)`
tail-jumps `0030B570(rcx, 1 when edx is non-zero else 0)`

returns at once unless `ecx` is 3; otherwise, on the object at `r8d` zero-extended, ORs 1 into dword `+0xC4` when `edx` is zero, or clears its bit 0 and ORs in 2 when `edx` is non-zero; when qword `+0xC8` is non-null calls `00247510(that qword, 0x1D, stack record)` with the record holding dword 3, a byte (byte `+0x39A` of the object at qword `02CA99C0`, or 0xFF when that is null) and dword `edx`; finally clears bit 1 of dword `+0xC0` when its bit 0 is clear

on `rcx` makes self-linked list heads at `+0x8` and `+0x18`, stores `rdx` at `+0x28`, links the `+0x8` node at the tail of the list headed at `01F401E8` (tail pointer `01F401F0`) and sets the table pointer at `+0` to `01CB23F8` (after first `01CB23C0`); calls `00808FE4(rcx+0x30, 0x48, 6, 00792D90, 0016D6A0)`; zeroes byte `+0x1E6`, qword `+0x1E8` and dword `+0x1F0` and, in a three-step loop, bytes `+0x1E0` to `+0x1E5` and `+0x1F4` to `+0x1F6`; returns `rcx`
sets `ecx` to 2 and tail-jumps `00796FC0` with the other argument registers unchanged

returns 9 when byte `+0x69` of `rcx` is non-zero; otherwise, when dword `+0x64` is zero, calls the virtual slot `+0x48` of `rcx` and returns its result when that is non-zero; in the remaining cases increments dword `+0x64` and tail-jumps `0079BDF0(qword +0x58)`
